intro: Apps, scripts and AI assistants that may read the club's data. They never have more rights than the person they act for, and every access is in the audit log.
members: Members may connect apps and make their own tokens
membersHint: Off: admins only. Through an app a member only sees what they see themselves.
aiHint: Claude may then read the club's data for people who connect it themselves. It cannot change anything. Off: the connector gets no data of the club.
none: No app or token has access.
endBody: The app or script can't read anything afterwards. Whoever uses it has to connect again.
